title: Patient Accounting Calculation Memorandum: Rounding the Add-On Share of a Patient Payment Plans Term Extension
content:
When an add-on lengthens the term of a Patient Payment Plans plan, the add-on share of the extension (the add-on amount divided by 6 times the plan's current installment) is rounded to whole months according to the payment reversals on the patient's Patient Financial Account.

**Measure.** The payment reversals the Patient Financial Account shows posted less than 12 whole months before the handling date.

**Rounding.**

| Payment reversals in that period | Rounding of the add-on share |
|---|---|
| None | Rounded up to whole months |
| Exactly one | Rounded half up to whole months |
| Two or more | Rounded down to whole months |

In words: with no reversal the add-on share is rounded up; with exactly one it is rounded half up; with two or more it is rounded down.

**Worked figures (hypothetical add-on shares).**

| Add-on share | No reversal | One reversal | Two or more reversals |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2.22 | 3 | 2 | 2 |
| 2.50 | 3 | 3 | 2 |
| 2.00 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| 0.40 | 1 | 0 | 0 |

Rounding half up to whole months takes a share of exactly one half above a whole number to the next whole month (2.50 becomes 3), and a share below that half to the whole number beneath it (2.22 becomes 2).
